materialFindings.detail: READY/SENT now has material MODE_SELECTED, SUBMIT_SUCCEEDED, and EDITED transitions. Empty programmatic clear preserves SENT; real non-empty editing returns stale SENT to READY.
SOURCE_WIRED now requires mode initialization/refresh plus READY/SENT/edit-recovery lifecycle. A partial state setter without edit recovery is PARTIAL_UNSAFE.
Exact current-owner surgery is CORRECTED_PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED and locked to owner blob c5de1411a6b68087ae17aff83c032af754587150. Authenticated owner readback remains legacy.
Existing source organism now makes SENT -> real edit -> READY touchable without stealing radio-group focus or claiming runtime proof.

correctionsPaid: Initial owner proposal replaced the existing richer per-mode content descriptions with generic policy action descriptions. Code-first review rejected that regression; corrected proposal preserves the existing descriptions and uses native selected state solely for selection truth.

Persistent SENT was initially under-specified as a state label. Lifecycle review established that non-empty new input is material unsent work and must return READY, while the programmatic empty clear after submit must preserve SENT.
Owner evidence that only saw READY/SENT setters could false-green stale SENT behavior. Probe v3 requires edit recovery before SOURCE_WIRED.
